_comment: Surface-level parity guardrail. Each VB Form (Designer form / distinct user-facing dialog) MUST bind to a dedicated port surface that reproduces its BEHAVIOUR, not just have its control-concepts appear somewhere globally. This catches the failure mode the symbol-ledger is blind to: two VB forms folded into one port surface (e.g. Basic + Advanced Settings), or a distinct dialog thinned into inline controls. Verdicts: DEDICATED = own port class/module reproducing the form; FOLDED_OK = intentionally merged into another surface AND full behaviour verified present; THINNED = merged but behaviour reduced (FINDING); MISSING = no port implementation (FINDING); DEFERRED = intentionally not ported (data-blocked / cross-platform / low-value). check_form_bindings.py FAILS on any THINNED/MISSING unless it carries "accepted": true (a conscious owner sign-off) -> fix-by-default.

Settings.note: curated tabs + FolderMapping; the VB per-preference ListView framework is intentional divergence, content covered; BasicSettings is now a SEPARATE surface

BasicSettings.note: distinct 2-tab curated dialog; Advanced chains to Settings (fixed 2026-07-24)

CreateInstaller.note: VB CreateInstaller is the build action + wizard prompts; ported (build is synchronous, wizard prompt = wizard_prefs)

FindDialogue.note: REVIEW: generic find-text dialog; verify the port text viewer offers find

WorkshopNameEditor.note: rename-mod editor folded into the Workshop viewer's Rename action

GameManager.note: REVIEW: backup/activate/deactivate/delete folded into GameSavesManager; verify parity with the full manager

GameSavesPathDialogue.note: save-path picker folded into the file dialog

ExtendedEditionDialogue.note: EE user/library folder specification via Settings Locations; first-run modal + disable-detection is intentional UX divergence (adjudicated 2026-07-24)

BikToWbmDialogue.note: conversion progress dialog folded; conversion is headless + synchronous

CalculateCRCs.note: CRC progress dialog folded; checksum calc is headless

MsgPicture.note: message-with-picture folded into standard message boxes

DownloadDeleteMsg.note: download-delete confirmation folded into a confirm dialog

NitDownload.note: download action folded into the Download Project flow

RtfThemeManager.note: VB recolours individual rich-text elements; port offers a single light/dark/system theme. Accepted bounded port (low value, accessibility subset).

MenuItemEditor.note: VB dedicated menu-item editor (text/URL/icon/accelerator) folded into inline Web-menu / Run-menu editors; the &-accelerator + icon-picker are Windows-menu-specific. Accepted bounded (low value).

CommonFiltersDialogue.note: Group + Rating include/exclude multi-select dialog, opened from the Mod Play Viewer Filters… button (fixed 2026-07-24)

CreateNwnFolder.note: FINDING: create a fresh NWN folder for a profile by copying a source (Settings.Profiles). No port equivalent; tied to the deferred Profiles page. Review whether the port's install-detection + Locations covers the workflow or this is a real gap.

BackupManager.note: shared-store / network-share sync; data-blocked (no NRBF writer, no shared store).
